questions.title: Truth assignments
questions.task: A says B and C have the same type. B says D is a liar. C says at least one of A,B is truthful. D says exactly two of A,B,C are truthful. Each person's truth type equals the truth value of their statement.

fields.assignments: All [A,B,C,D] Boolean vectors, lexicographically sorted (false before true).

questions.title: Shared diagnostic batch
questions.task: Disease prevalence 1/100. A batch is defective with probability 1/10 independently of disease; defective tests are always positive. Otherwise tests are conditionally independent with sensitivity 19/20 and false-positive rate 1/50. Two tests use the SAME batch.

questions.title: Causal bounds
questions.task: P(X=0,Y=0)=P(X=1,Y=1)=1/2. Binary potential outcomes obey consistency only. Find sharp bounds on E[Y(1)-Y(0)].

questions.title: Unsatisfiable core certificate
questions.task: Integers x,y,z in {0,1,2}. C1:x!=y; C2:y!=z; C3:z!=x; C4:x+y+z=2.

fields.core: Indices of the smallest unsatisfiable constraint set, ascending integers 1..4.
fields.removal_witnesses: For each removed core member, in core order, the lexicographically SMALLEST satisfying [x,y,z] for all remaining core members.

questions.title: Robust sensors
questions.task: Reports:1,2,3,10,11,12,13. At most two arbitrary; all others within 5 inclusive of one real theta.

fields.feasible: Entire feasible set as ascending numbers (it is finite).

questions.title: Exactly once
questions.task: External payment API: no idempotency, no query, no shared Redis transaction. Ambiguous timeouts and crashes anywhere; eventual availability. Require eventual payment AND no duplicate effect. Choose a sufficient extra capability: A=separate success log after charge; B=durable atomic effect deduplication by stable key with replayable outcome; C=random retry delay.

fields.sufficient_capability: One string: A, B or C.

questions.title: Linearizable history
questions.task: Register starts0. W1:[0,4] writes1; W2:[1,2] writes2; R1:[3,5] reads1; R2:[4.5,6] reads2. Then modify ONLY R2 invocation to3.5. Linearization respects real-time nonoverlap.

fields.modified_order: Lexicographically smallest valid operation-name order for modified history (R1<R2<W1<W2).

questions.title: Optimal WorkGraph
questions.task: One nonpreemptive Worker starts0, no idle required. Items (duration,weight,predecessors): A(2,1,[]), B(1,4,[]), C(3,1,[]), D(2,2,[A]), E(2,8,[A,B]), F(1,2,[C]), G(2,3,[D,E]), H(1,1,[F,G]). Minimize weighted completion sum.

fields.order: Lexicographically first optimal array of item names.

questions.title: Quantifiers
questions.task: Is forall runs r exists schema s forall ops in r validates(s,op) equivalent to exists s forall r forall ops validates(s,op)? Runs must be nonempty; schema set nonempty.

fields.minimum_counterexample: [number of runs, number of schemas], minimize each.

questions.title: Quorums
questions.task: 7 replicas, at most2 Byzantine. Any write/write and read/write quorum pair must intersect in an honest replica. Minimize max(w,r).

fields.intersection_alone_linearizable: Boolean: do these intersections ALONE specify a linearizable protocol?

questions.title: Pairwise independence
questions.task: X,Y,Z fair bits, each pair independent; no mutual independence. Bound P(111).

questions.title: Testing limits
questions.task: Deterministic function domain: all finite byte strings; outputs Boolean. A finite test suite matches a reference. Then restrict input domain to ALL byte strings length<=2 and exhaustively test.

fields.restricted_domain_size: Exact integer input count including empty string.

questions.title: Rewriting
questions.task: Rules ab->baa and b->empty, applied anywhere to finite strings over a,b. Is every rewrite sequence terminating? Enumerate all irreducible descendants of input ab.

fields.normal_forms_ab: Lexicographically sorted array of distinct strings.

questions.title: Banker
questions.task: Total resources(3,3). Allocated P1(1,0),P2(0,1),P3(1,1). Maxima P1(3,1),P2(1,3),P3(2,2).

fields.safe_sequence: Lexicographically smallest safe process-name array for current state.

questions.title: Micro encoding
questions.task: Fixed request-independent dictionary. Arbitrary uniform256-bit requests. External framing permits all binary strings length<=255. Separately require prefix-free codes.

fields.codeword_deficit: Integer: number of requests minus number of available externally framed codewords.
fields.minimum_prefix_mean_bits: Rational string: minimum expected prefix-free length.

questions.title: DAG admission trace
questions.task: limit=2. Ready admission lexical, refill after processing an entire completion batch, reject failures before refill. A,B initially ready. C dependsA; D dependsB. A,B admitted t0. B completes t1; D completes t2; A completes t3; C completes t4. Separate run: A and B fail in SAME observed batch.

fields.admission: Array of admitted names in chronological admission order.
fields.propagated_failure: Name whose failure must propagate in separate run (lexical tie rule).

questions.title: Filesystem containment
questions.task: Choose all designs sufficient against intermediate symlink swaps (no directory reparenting or malicious staging changes; trusted root/staging dirs). A=resolve/check then path write; B=O_NOFOLLOW on final component only; C=pin root fd, no-follow each component, exclusive fresh inode in trusted staging and dir-relative rename; D=string startswith(root).

fields.hardlink_truncation_safe: Boolean: is opening/truncating an existing final hardlinked inode sufficient to avoid modifying an external inode?

questions.title: Snapshot cycle
questions.task: Capsules read OLD snapshot. A reads config and writes port; B reads port and writes adapter; C reads adapter and writes config. Serialization edge reader->other-writer.

questions.title: Commit recovery
questions.task: Durable immutable PREPARED record contains base B and candidate C. Git CAS B->C succeeded, process crashed before Redis finalize. Branch is now D, a descendant of C; no force resets allowed. Actions: A=apply patch again; B=finalize receipt for C; C=reset branch to B.

fields.cross_store_atomic_visibility: Boolean: does this protocol give simultaneous atomic Git+Redis visibility?

questions.title: SingleFlight
questions.task: One loop; one live shared task per key. Each caller awaits asyncio.shield(task). Waiters A,B share keyK. A cancels while task running, B remains. Cleanup callback deletes registry entry only if its value is the completed task. A stale callback runs after a NEW task was installed.

fields.shared_task_cancelled: Boolean: does cancellation of A alone cancel the shared task?

questions.title: JSON Lines bytes
questions.task: Strict UTF-8 JSONL parser, max4 raw bytes per record excluding LF but INCLUDING CR before optional CRLF stripping. Strict JSON rejects NaN. Input records separately: bytes for 1234+LF; 1234+CR+LF; JSON string containing é+LF (UTF-8); NaN+LF.

fields.accepted: Boolean array for the four records.
fields.unicode_record_bytes: Raw byte count excluding LF for the third record.

questions.title: Relevant negative cycles
questions.task: Directed weighted edges:0->1(1),1->2(-2),2->1(1),0->3(5),3->4(2). Source0. Shortest walk distances; a reachable negative cycle matters only if it can reach target.

fields.to_4: Integer shortest distance before adding any edge.
fields.to_4_after_edge: After adding2->4(0), use integer, null for unreachable, or string -inf.

questions.title: Generator trace

fields.stdout: Array of output line STRINGS in order.

questions.title: Tombstone ranking
questions.task: Rows(resource,version,event,deleted,payload): (a,1,10,false,old),(a,2,11,true,gone),(b,2,20,false,left),(b,2,21,false,right),(c,3,30,false,new). cutoff2. Select latest by version DESC,event DESC per resource, THEN filter deleted. Sort output by resource.

fields.filter_deleted_first_resurrects: Sorted array of resources incorrectly resurrected by filtering tombstones before ranking.

questions.title: Write skew
questions.task: Two doctors initially on call. Each snapshot transaction reads both, and if another is on-call turns ONLY its own row off. Both read before either commits. Ordinary snapshot isolation, no shared locks. Then choose sufficient remedies: A=true serializable plus retry; B=own-row locks only; C=shared guard row locked before a fresh READ COMMITTED read and held through commit.

questions.title: Expression evaluator
questions.task: Python arithmetic precedence; whitelist finite float literals, +,-,*,/,**, unary+/- and sqrt/sin/log bare one-argument calls. Every literal<=1e6 abs, every result<=1e12 abs, exponent abs<=10. Reject bools, names, attributes, domains, nonfinite results. Evaluate independently: -2**2; 2**3**2; sqrt(9)+sin(0); 1/0; True; (-1)**0.5; 2**11.

fields.outcomes: Array of number results or string ERROR.

questions.title: Process timeout
questions.task: Linux parent P starts in new session/process group id P. P spawns child C in SAME group; C retains stdout. P exits at0.1s; C still running at deadline1s. Deadline applies until P exited AND streams EOF. Group TERM at1s; C ignores TERM. KILL after grace0.2s. No escapes, all killable/reapable.

fields.signals: Array [time in milliseconds, signal name, target kind], target kind string process_group.
fields.return_at_parent_exit: Boolean: may runner return at0.1s with successful complete capture?

questions.title: Closable queue
questions.task: Capacity1 FIFO contains x. close() occurs; then get(), get(), put(y). Closed is terminal for new puts; existing items drain. Separate full queue has a blocked producer; close() must wake it.

fields.results: Strings for three operations: returned item or Closed.

questions.title: Runtime validation
questions.task: External plain or null-prototype JS object: exact own keys kind,paths; kind='scan'; paths dense array of nonempty strings (whitespace counts nonempty). Reject symbols, extras, sparse holes, inherited-only keys. Candidates: A={kind:'scan',paths:[' ']}; B=same plus own Symbol key; C=paths array length1 with a hole; D=null-prototype object with kind:'scan',paths:['x']; E=paths:[''].

fields.array_every_detects_holes: Boolean: does every(callback) necessarily visit missing indices?

questions.title: C17 semantics
questions.task: Classify A=printf('%d %d',i++,i++) (assume valid double-quoted format); B=UINT_MAX+1u; C=dereference one-past int[2]; D=INT_MIN/-1 on two's-complement int. Classifications exactly UB or defined. Then consider D on permitted C17 symmetric signed range INT_MIN=-INT_MAX.

questions.title: Lazy median storage
questions.task: Sliding median uses two heaps and lazy deletion with k=3, no physical rebuilding. Feed strictly increasing stream of unbounded length n. Choose repair: A=drop multiplicities via set; B=when physical entries>3k rebuild from exact current deque incl duplicates and clear tombstones; C=keep only increasing values.

fields.unrebuilt_physical_bound: String O(k) or Theta(n), worst case.

questions.title: Overflow-free mulmod
questions.task: Unsigned64 mathematical modular multiplication. a=18446744073709551614, b=18446744073709551613, m=18446744073709551557. Second fixture a=123,b=456,m=1. No intermediate wraparound in requested answers.

questions.title: Delta debugging
questions.task: Ordered subsequences of [a,b,c,d]. Predicate fails EXACTLY on [a,b,c,d], [a,b], [c]. Current output[a,b]. 1-minimal means failing but no single deletion still fails. Global minimum means shortest failing subsequence of original.

questions.title: Micro contract parser
questions.task: Exact ASCII grammar: v1|mul|NAME:TYPE,NAME:TYPE->NAME:TYPE. NAME=[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,7}; TYPE=i64 or f64; all3 names distinct; all3 types identical; full string consumed; no whitespace. Inputs A=v1|mul|x:i64,y:i64->z:i64; B=v1|mul|x:i64,x:i64->z:i64; C=v1|mul|x:f64,y:i64->z:f64; D=A followed by newline; E=v1|mul|a:f64,b:f64->c:f64. Runtime i64 product2^62*4.

fields.runtime_product: String OVERFLOW or integer result under checked i64.

questions.title: Stable roots
questions.task: For quadratic coefficients(1,-10^16,1), stable q=-0.5*(b+copysign(sqrt(b*b-4*a*c),b)); roots q/a and c/q. Round the two exact real roots to ONE significant decimal digit, obtaining powers of10. What are those powers' exponents? Separately coefficients(1,0,0).

fields.root_scale_exponents: Ascending two integer exponents (not floors of the unrounded logarithms).
fields.zero_case_roots: Sorted exact two numeric roots for separate fixture.

questions.title: Power tower
questions.task: 7^(7^7) mod1000; right associative. Also compute exponent7^7 mod400.

questions.title: Improper integral
questions.task: I=integral_0^infinity ln(x)*ln(1+x)/(1+x)^2 dx. Return coefficient c in I=c*pi^2. Also S=sum_{k>=1}1/[k(k+1)^2] in form a+b*pi^2.

questions.title: Monic minimax quartic
questions.task: On[-1,1], minimize sup abs(p) for monic quartic p. Give coefficients descending x^4..x^0 and norm.

questions.title: Pell certificate
questions.task: Smallest positive Pell solution x^2-13y^2=1,y>0. Also give periodic continued fraction sqrt13=[a0;overline(period)].

fields.period: Periodic entries only, canonical shortest period starting immediately after a0.

questions.title: Random F2 matrix
questions.task: 6x6 matrix of independent fair F2 bits.

questions.title: Coin patterns
questions.task: Fair independent coin tosses until first HTH or HHT as contiguous substring.

questions.title: Conditional exponential
questions.task: Independent X,Y~Exp(1). E[X|X+Y>t]=(a*t^2+b*t+c)/(d*t+e), with primitive positive integer coefficients and gcd(a,b,c,d,e)=1.

fields.limits: [pointwise limit at every x, limit integral f_n, limit integral x*f_n], rational strings.
fields.integrable_dominator_exists: Boolean: one integrable function bounds all f_n.

questions.title: Jordan growth
questions.task: A4x4 has ones on diagonal and immediately above, zeros elsewhere. Compute A^10. Also limit ||A^n||_2/n^3.

questions.title: Constrained product
questions.task: x,y,z>=0; x+y+z=6; x^2+y^2+z^2=14. Write each extreme of xyz in basis1,sqrt3: a+b*sqrt3. All ordered triples count separately.

fields.ordered_equality_counts: [number minimizing triples, number maximizing triples], integers.

questions.title: Circular strings
questions.task: Length20 binary strings, exactly6 ones, no adjacent ones including cyclic boundary. Necklaces identify rotations, not reflections.

questions.title: Modular roots
questions.task: All x in[0,4095] with x^2=1 mod4096.

questions.title: Minimal polynomial
questions.task: alpha=sqrt2+sqrt3+sqrt5 overQ. Give its monic minimal polynomial and algebraic degree.

fields.coefficients: Integer coefficients descending x^8..x^0, including zeros.

questions.title: Expected determinant
questions.task: A,B,C,D independent uniform[0,1]. U=AD has CDF F(t)=t(1-ln(t)),0<t<1.

fields.integrals: [integral_0^1 F(t)dt, integral_0^1 F(t)^2 dt], rational strings.

questions.title: Sharp information inequality
questions.task: For p,q in(0,1), natural-log Bernoulli KL D(p||q)>=C*(p-q)^2. Find largest universal C. Equality set in original domain, with that optimal C: A=p=q; B=p+q=1; C=p=1/2; D=never.
